# Golden HPC Study

A normalized downloaded-data HPC golden project.

## Start Here

Read `prompts/AI_CONTEXT.md` with your coding assistant, then record each run
and its output under `results/logs/`. Keep hypotheses, scripts, logs, and
analysis linked so the work remains reproducible.

Use `python scripts/new_script.py --help` to create a numbered, log-producing
experiment scaffold. See `docs/12_STEPS.md` for the complete research loop.
